## Actions

- Audited Cross Flow funnel observability and authored the attribution formula adopted for Growth Experiment Impact Estimation, exposing more than 10% over-attribution in the prior approach and prompting back-porting across earlier productionisation projects.
- Aligned Shared Experiment Flow / Next Flow migration work with Experiment Lifecycle Commitments and shipped a site-select tenant propagation fix.
- Configured Opsgenie so Sev 3 alerting for experiments was managed separately from productionised experiences.
- Created the Multipliers Experiment Design Template after recurring attribution and experiment-design issues surfaced during transition out of the M50 role.

## Scope

Cross Flow experiment measurement and shared experiment-flow foundations during FY24H1, spanning the Multipliers EM to IC transition.

## Outcomes

Adopted methodology exposed more than 10% over-attribution in the prior approach and was back-ported to earlier productionisation projects.

## Metrics

- prior-approach over-attribution exposed: >10%
- additional users reached via site-select tenant propagation fix: ~20%

## Technologies

Cross Flow Goals dashboard, Shared Experiment Flow, Next Flow, Opsgenie, experiment attribution
